stories.title: Points Accrual on Purchase Transaction
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want to earn points automatically when I make a purchase, so that my loyalty balance grows with every transaction
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed purchase transaction is received via API, When the accrual engine processes it, Then points are calculated as transaction_amount × accrual_rate (default 1 point per £1) rounded down to nearest integer and a ledger entry is created
Given the ledger entry is created, When the balance is updated, Then the customer's cached balance is updated atomically and a 'points.earned' event is emitted to the event bus
Given a transaction with amount £0 or negative, When submitted to the accrual engine, Then it is rejected with error 'invalid_transaction_amount' and no ledger entry is created
Given the accrual engine processes a transaction, When end-to-end processing completes, Then it finishes within 2 seconds
Given the points ledger contains customer financial data, When any accrual is processed, Then all data is encrypted at rest and access is restricted to authorized services only

requirements_used: FR-01 — Points Accrual on Purchase — configurable rate, all channels, only after finalization
NFR-08 — Data Consistency — strongly consistent balance
architecture_kb_sections: enterprise-architecture §3.2 (Cloud SQL PostgreSQL for transactional data)

stories.reasoning: 5 points: core accrual logic + atomic balance update + event emission + validation. This is the heart of the loyalty engine. Security AC included due to Confidential data sensitivity.

stories.title: Idempotent Transaction Processing
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want the system to prevent duplicate points from being awarded for the same purchase, so that my balance is always accurate
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction with a transaction_id that has already been processed, When it is submitted again, Then the system rejects it with error 'duplicate_transaction' and returns the original ledger entry reference
Given two identical transactions arrive simultaneously, When processed concurrently, Then only one ledger entry is created due to unique constraint on transaction_id
Given a transaction for a customer_id that does not exist, When submitted, Then it is queued to a retry queue with reason 'customer_not_found' for later processing

requirements_used: FR-01 — Points Accrual on Purchase — only after finalization
NFR-08 — Data Consistency

stories.reasoning: 3 points: idempotency check + concurrent handling + retry queue. Critical fraud prevention — without this, replayed webhooks could double-credit customers.

stories.title: Real-Time Points Balance Display
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want to see my current points balance and its monetary equivalent on my dashboard, so that I know how much I've earned and what it's worth
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, When I view my dashboard, Then I see my current available points balance displayed prominently with the equivalent monetary value (e.g., '500 points = £25')
Given a points transaction occurs on my account, When the balance changes, Then my displayed balance updates within 2 seconds via WebSocket push without requiring a page refresh
Given the cache is unavailable, When I request my balance, Then the system falls back to calculating from the ledger (sum of all transactions) and returns the correct balance
Given the balance display, When navigated via screen reader, Then the balance and monetary equivalent are announced clearly (e.g., 'Your balance is 500 points, equivalent to 25 pounds')

requirements_used: FR-05 — Real-Time Points Balance Display — updated within 2 seconds, visible in app and online account

stories.reasoning: 5 points: WebSocket integration + Redis cache + fallback logic + UI component. Accessibility AC for user-facing screen. Security AC implicit via Confidential sensitivity.

stories.title: Offline Balance Display on Mobile
stories.user_story: As Nathan, a loyalty customer, I want to see my last known points balance when I'm offline, so that I have an idea of my balance even without connectivity
acceptance_criteria: Given I have previously loaded my balance while online, When I open the app without network connectivity, Then I see my cached balance with a 'Last updated: {timestamp}' label
Given I am offline and viewing cached balance, When network connectivity is restored, Then the balance refreshes silently and the 'Last updated' label is removed

requirements_used: FR-05 — Real-Time Points Balance Display
NFR-09 — Mobile App Performance — offline graceful degradation

stories.reasoning: 2 points: local storage persistence + connectivity detection. Ensures mobile users always have some balance visibility per NFR-09.

stories.title: Push Notification on Points Earned
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want to receive a push notification when I earn points, so that I get instant confirmation of my loyalty reward
acceptance_criteria: Given a 'points.earned' event is emitted, When the notification service processes it, Then a push notification is delivered to my device within 30 seconds with content: 'You earned {points} points on your {channel} purchase! New balance: {balance} points.'
Given push delivery fails, When the service retries, Then it attempts 3 retries with exponential backoff before falling back to email
Given I have disabled transactional notifications in my preferences, When points are earned, Then no push notification is sent but the notification is still stored in the in-app center
Given the notification contains my points balance, When stored or transmitted, Then it is encrypted in transit and the balance is not logged in plain text in service logs

requirements_used: FR-07 — Points Accrual Notification — push notification within 30 seconds showing points earned, transaction reference, new balance

stories.reasoning: 3 points: event consumption + notification delivery + preference check + retry logic. Security AC for Confidential data in notifications.

stories.title: In-App Notification for Points Earned
stories.user_story: As Nathan, a loyalty customer, I want earn notifications stored in my notification center, so that I can review them later if I missed the push
acceptance_criteria: Given a points earned notification is generated, When it is delivered, Then it is also persisted in the in-app notification center with title, body, timestamp, and unread status
Given I open the notification center, When I view earn notifications, Then they show the points earned, channel, and new balance in a readable format
Given the notification center list, When navigated via screen reader, Then each notification is announced with its title, time ago, and read/unread status

requirements_used: FR-07 — Points Accrual Notification

stories.reasoning: 2 points: storage + list display. Accessibility AC for user-facing notification center. Separated from push delivery because it's a distinct UI concern.

stories.title: Customer Identification via Phone Number at POS
stories.user_story: As Sana, a store associate, I want to look up a customer by phone number at the POS, so that I can link their purchase to their loyalty account
acceptance_criteria: Given I enter a customer's phone number at the POS, When I submit the lookup, Then the API returns the customer's name, tier, points balance, and member_since date within 2 seconds
Given I enter a phone number that doesn't match any customer, When the lookup completes, Then I see a 'Customer not found' message with an option to register them
Given the lookup API, When more than 30 requests are made from my POS terminal in one minute, Then subsequent requests receive 429 Too Many Requests
Given the lookup returns customer data, When displayed to staff, Then email and phone are partially masked (e.g., j***@email.com, ***1234)

requirements_used: FR-15 — Customer Identification at POS — phone number, loyalty ID, QR code scan from app

stories.reasoning: 3 points: API endpoint + phone lookup + rate limiting + PII masking. Security AC for rate limiting to prevent enumeration attacks on phone numbers.

stories.title: Customer Identification via Loyalty ID at POS
stories.user_story: As Sana, a store associate, I want to look up a customer by their loyalty ID, so that I can quickly identify them when they provide their membership number
acceptance_criteria: Given I enter a 10-digit loyalty ID at the POS, When I submit the lookup, Then the API returns the customer's loyalty summary (name, tier, balance, member_since) within 2 seconds
Given I enter a loyalty ID that doesn't exist, When the lookup completes, Then I see 'Invalid loyalty ID — please check and try again'
Given I enter a value that is not 10 digits, When I attempt to submit, Then the input is rejected with inline validation 'Loyalty ID must be exactly 10 digits'

requirements_used: FR-15 — Customer Identification at POS — phone number, loyalty ID, QR code scan from app

stories.reasoning: 2 points: reuses lookup infrastructure from US-031 with different identifier. Input validation prevents unnecessary API calls.

stories.title: Customer Identification via QR Code at POS
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want to show a QR code on my app for the store associate to scan, so that I can be identified quickly without sharing personal details
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in to the app, When I open the 'My QR Code' screen, Then a QR code is displayed containing my encrypted customer_id that refreshes every 60 seconds
Given Sana scans my QR code at the POS, When the system decodes it, Then it returns my loyalty summary within 2 seconds
Given a QR code that has expired (older than 60 seconds), When scanned, Then the system rejects it with 'QR code expired — please ask customer to refresh'
Given the QR code screen, When accessed via screen reader, Then it announces 'Your loyalty QR code — show this to the store associate to earn points'

requirements_used: FR-15 — Customer Identification at POS — QR code scan from app

stories.reasoning: 5 points: QR generation + encryption + 60s refresh + POS decode + expiry validation. Dynamic QR prevents screenshot replay attacks. Accessibility AC for user-facing screen.

stories.title: Points Transaction History List
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want to see a chronological list of all my points transactions, so that I can track how I've earned and spent my points
acceptance_criteria: Given I navigate to transaction history, When the screen loads, Then I see a list of transactions showing: date/time, type (earned/redeemed/adjusted/expired), points amount (+/-), running balance, reference (order ID), and channel icon
Given I have more than 20 transactions, When I scroll to the bottom of the list, Then the Dunelm page loads automatically (infinite scroll) with a loading indicator
Given I have no transactions, When I view the history screen, Then I see an empty state: 'No transactions yet — make a purchase to start earning!'
Given the transaction history screen, When navigated via screen reader, Then each transaction row is announced with type, points, date, and channel

requirements_used: FR-18 — Points Transaction History — chronological, accruals with purchase reference, pagination and date filtering

stories.reasoning: 5 points: paginated list + multiple data fields + empty state + infinite scroll. Accessibility AC for user-facing screen.

stories.title: Transaction History Filtering
stories.user_story: As Nathan, a loyalty customer, I want to filter my transaction history by date range and type, so that I can find specific transactions quickly
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the transaction history screen, When I select a date range filter, Then only transactions within that range are displayed
Given I select a transaction type filter (e.g., 'Earned only'), When applied, Then only transactions of that type are shown with the filter visually indicated
Given I have filters applied, When I clear all filters, Then the full transaction list is restored to newest-first default

requirements_used: FR-18 — Points Transaction History — pagination and date filtering

stories.reasoning: 3 points: date picker + type dropdown + filter state management + API query params. Separated from list story to keep each focused.

stories.title: Points Reversal on Full Refund
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want points to be automatically deducted when I return a purchase, so that the loyalty system stays fair and accurate
acceptance_criteria: Given a full refund event is received for an order, When the original transaction is found in the ledger, Then the full points earned are reversed with a ledger entry {type: 'reversal', points: -N, reference_id: original_order_id, reason: 'return'}
Given the reversal is processed, When my balance is updated, Then I receive a notification: 'Points adjusted: {points} points deducted due to return of order {order_id}. New balance: {balance}.'
Given a refund event for a transaction older than 90 days, When submitted, Then it is rejected with 'reversal_time_limit_exceeded' and no points are deducted
Given the reversal involves financial ledger data, When processed, Then the operation is logged to the audit trail with before/after balance states

requirements_used: FR-23 — Points Reversal on Return/Refund — auto-deduct on return, track negative balance, offset against future accruals

stories.reasoning: 5 points: lookup original transaction + calculate reversal + ledger entry + notification + time limit check. Critical financial integrity feature.

stories.title: Points Reversal on Partial Refund
stories.user_story: As Nathan, a loyalty customer, I want only the proportional points deducted when I do a partial return, so that I keep points for items I didn't return
acceptance_criteria: Given a partial refund event is received, When the refund amount is less than the original order total, Then points reversed are calculated proportionally: original_points × (refund_amount / original_order_total) rounded down
Given the partial reversal is processed, When my balance is updated, Then the notification shows the partial deduction amount and new balance

requirements_used: FR-23 — Points Reversal on Return/Refund

stories.reasoning: 3 points: proportional calculation logic + integration with reversal engine. Separated from full refund because the calculation logic is distinct.

stories.title: Negative Balance Handling on Reversal
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer who has already spent my points, I want returns to be processed even if my balance would go negative, so that I'm not blocked from returning items
acceptance_criteria: Given my current balance is less than the reversal amount, When a return is processed, Then my balance is set to 0 and a 'negative_balance' deficit record is created tracking the shortfall
Given I have a negative balance deficit, When I earn new points on a future purchase, Then the deficit is offset first before crediting my visible balance
Given I have a deficit of 50 points and earn 30 points, When the accrual processes, Then my visible balance remains 0 and the deficit reduces to 20 points

requirements_used: FR-23 — Points Reversal on Return/Refund — track negative balance, offset against future accruals

stories.reasoning: 3 points: negative balance tracking + deficit offset logic on future accruals. Prevents blocking returns while maintaining financial integrity.

stories.title: E-commerce Webhook Receiver
stories.user_story: As a platform engineer, I want a webhook receiver that ingests purchase and refund events from the e-commerce platform, so that online transactions flow into the loyalty system automatically
acceptance_criteria: Given the e-commerce platform sends an order.completed webhook, When received, Then the webhook signature is validated (HMAC-SHA256) and the payload is parsed to extract customer_email, order_id, total_amount, and channel
Given a valid webhook payload, When the customer_email is mapped to a loyalty customer_id, Then the transaction is forwarded to the points accrual engine
Given a webhook with an invalid or missing HMAC signature, When received, Then it is rejected with 403 Forbidden and the attempt is logged as a security event
Given a webhook for a customer_email not found in the loyalty system, When received, Then it is placed in the dead letter queue for manual review with reason 'customer_not_found'

requirements_used: FR-01 — Points Accrual on Purchase — regardless of channel

stories.reasoning: 5 points: webhook receiver + HMAC validation + payload parsing + customer mapping + DLQ. Security AC for signature validation to prevent spoofed events.

stories.title: POS Event Adapter
stories.user_story: As a platform engineer, I want a POS event adapter that receives in-store transaction events, so that in-store purchases earn loyalty points
acceptance_criteria: Given the POS system sends a transaction event via REST API, When received, Then it is validated, parsed, and forwarded to the points accrual engine with channel set to 'in-store'
Given the POS system uses file-based polling (legacy fallback), When new transaction files are detected, Then they are parsed and processed within 5 minutes of file creation
Given the loyalty engine is temporarily unavailable, When events arrive, Then they are queued and retried with exponential backoff until successfully processed

requirements_used: FR-01 — Points Accrual on Purchase — regardless of channel
FR-23 — Points Reversal on Return/Refund

stories.reasoning: 5 points: REST receiver + file polling fallback + queue + retry logic. File-based fallback addresses legacy POS systems per CON-01.

stories.title: Dead Letter Queue and Event Deduplication
stories.user_story: As a platform engineer, I want unprocessable events stored in a dead letter queue and duplicate events rejected, so that no events are lost and none are processed twice
acceptance_criteria: Given an event cannot be processed after 3 retry attempts, When the final retry fails, Then it is moved to the dead letter queue with: event_payload, failure_reason, retry_count, last_attempt_timestamp
Given an event with the same order_id + event_type combination arrives, When checked against processed events, Then it is rejected as duplicate and not forwarded to the accrual engine
Given events in the DLQ, When a support engineer queries them, Then they can view, retry, or dismiss events via the admin API

requirements_used: FR-01 — Points Accrual on Purchase
NFR-05 — 99.9% Uptime

stories.reasoning: 3 points: DLQ storage + deduplication check + admin retry API. Ensures no events are silently lost and prevents double-crediting.

stories.title: Configurable Accrual Rate
stories.user_story: As a loyalty program manager, I want the points accrual rate to be configurable without code changes, so that I can adjust the earn rate based on business needs
acceptance_criteria: Given the accrual rate is configured to 2 points per £1, When a £50 purchase is processed, Then 100 points are awarded
Given the accrual rate is changed, When the Dunelm transaction arrives, Then it uses the new rate immediately without requiring a deployment
Given an invalid rate value (0 or negative) is set, When the configuration is saved, Then it is rejected with a validation error and the previous rate remains active

requirements_used: FR-01 — Points Accrual on Purchase — configurable rate

stories.reasoning: 2 points: config read + validation + hot-reload. Enables business agility without engineering involvement.

stories.title: Transaction History API
stories.user_story: As a backend developer, I want a paginated transaction history API, so that both mobile and web clients can retrieve customer transaction data efficiently
acceptance_criteria: Given a GET request to /v1/customers/{id}/transactions, When called with page=1&limit=20, Then it returns the 20 most recent transactions with pagination metadata (total_count, has_Dunelm_page)
Given filter parameters type=earn&from=2026-01-01&to=2026-06-30, When applied, Then only matching transactions are returned
Given a request for another customer's transactions, When the authenticated customer_id doesn't match the requested id, Then it returns 403 Forbidden

requirements_used: FR-18 — Points Transaction History — pagination and date filtering

stories.reasoning: 3 points: paginated query + filtering + authorization check. Security AC ensures customers can only access their own data.

regression_summary.recommendation: Greenfield — no regression testing needed. All stories are new capabilities.
